claims.text: The proposed intervention is to maintain the LPBF build platform at approximately 300°C.
Preheating the build platform to approximately 300°C will moderate the thermal gradient across the melt-pool/substrate interface.
An elevated build-platform temperature decreases the temperature differential between the melt pool and the bulk material.
Decreasing the melt-pool-to-bulk temperature differential reduces the cooling rate.
Steep thermal gradients lead to residual stress in LPBF AlCrFeNiSi components.
Steep thermal gradients lead to microstructural heterogeneity in LPBF AlCrFeNiSi components.
Platform preheating will reduce residual stress relative to processing with an ambient-temperature platform.
Platform preheating will produce a more uniform grain structure relative to processing with an ambient-temperature platform.
Platform preheating will enhance ductility relative to processing with an ambient-temperature platform.
Platform preheating will enhance strength relative to processing with an ambient-temperature platform.
A controlled inert atmosphere mitigates oxidation risk during elevated-temperature LPBF processing.
Controlled atmosphere and oxidation inhibitors can prevent phase instability during elevated-temperature processing.
Ambient-platform LPBF of AlCrFeNiSi produces steep thermal gradients.
Ambient-platform LPBF of AlCrFeNiSi produces high residual stresses.
Ambient-platform LPBF of AlCrFeNiSi produces microstructural inhomogeneities.

The proposed approximately 300°C preheating approach is applicable to miniature AlCrFeNiSi component geometries when laser power, scan speed, and hatch spacing are optimized and oxidation is suppressed.
Elevated substrate temperatures may cause oxidation in AlCrFeNiSi.
Elevated substrate temperatures may cause phase instability in AlCrFeNiSi.

contradictions.description: The hypothesis presents platform preheating as the single intervention and the experiment says platform temperature is the only variable, but the heated arm is specifically assigned a controlled atmosphere with oxidation inhibition while the ambient arm is not explicitly assigned the same atmosphere. If these conditions differ between arms, atmosphere or inhibitor use becomes an additional intervention and confound.
